answer: Rio Tinto reported 1 fatality at managed operations in 2025 versus 5 in 2024. AIFR was 0.37 per 200,000 hours worked in both 2025 and 2024; the 2025 target was 0.38, so the reported rate was 0.01 below the target.

evidence.quote: 1 fatality at managed operations. (2024: 5 fatalities). All-injury frequency rate (AIFR) at 0.37 (target: 0.38). (2024: 0.37).
Our all-injury frequency rate (AIFR) remained at 0.37 in 2025, consistent with 2024.
